name: codee
description: Rigorous Mathematical Coding: implement explicit research-level mathematical constructions as annotated executable code, run practical checks, and report concise results across mathematical domains.

interface.longDescription: Rigorous Mathematical Coding: turn explicit constructions, examples, algorithms and counterexamples from mathematical papers, Writee manuscripts and Researchee handoffs into well-commented executable code. Run available mathematical software to check both faithful implementation and claimed mathematical properties, and present concise execution results without default lengthy reports.
defaultPrompt: 请读取这篇数学论文，提取显式构造，选择合适的数学软件，生成可运行且可验证的代码。
请对这篇论文中的反例进行完整计算认证：建立验证义务依赖图、生成程序和证书，逐项报告真实执行状态。
请接收 Researchee 的 handoff 或 Writee 的论文，将其中的显式数学构造编译为研究级程序。
